more_info.overview: Phosphated distarch phosphate is used as a stabilizer in food. Its technological role is to help maintain the structure of food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Starch receives both monophosphate esterification and phosphate crosslinking treatments. The product is a chemically modified carbohydrate.
